name: pavilion
kind: custom HyperFrames + three.js composition (not a terrain world)
explicit_constraints: Korean bronze bell (beomjong) as LatheGeometry: rounded shoulder, almost straight barrel widening slightly to the lip, no Western flare
raised bands top/bottom as lathe rings
two yugwak panels with 3x3 knobs facing camera
dragon loop (tube on an S curve) + sound tube
striker log ~1.6x bell height on two ropes, pivot at the beam
key light upper-left, soft fill, rim from behind
separate transparent layers: pavilion_bg, bell, log (15 frames, theta -12..+30 deg), each lit + flat ID pass
inferred_details: orthographic front camera, 1 px = 1.389 world units, 720x1008 = the 1000x1400 safe frame
dangjwa placed at screen angle +36 deg so the log hits it from the right (strike point = log tip at theta 0: (562,818))
log tip at x=570 at theta 0; rope length 630; ropes at x=760 and x=1000
rafter ends drawn as domed cylinders in two staggered rows
layers are mirror-tiled sideways for wide screens
